Jordan: Hey team — Banyan Health noticed a spike in errors during the UK pilot this morning. They're asking for a short regional QPS increase and a UK-edge CIDR allow for a 48h canary while they finish scaling. Renewal conversation next Tue; want to avoid SLA noise.
Rosa (Banyan): saw ~5xx around 02:15 UTC, sending logs now. Can we get +50% QPS for eu-west-2 or uk-south for 48h? Our app retries and it's compounding.
Sam (Solutions Eng): we can do a provisional rate window. Need exact CIDRs and preferred region. Note: routing to eu-west-2 might be simpler than setting up peering to UK — latency tradeoff ~8-12ms.
Priya (Infra): I can create a temporary rate window and add CIDR allow entries. Example config I'll apply once we have CIDRs:
```
service: rate-window
org: banyan-health
qps_multiplier: 1.5
expires: 2026-03-25T14:00Z
regions: [eu-west-2]
notes: "temp for canary; auto-revoke"
```
Priya (Infra): if they insist on UK edge peering we need a short peering request (ops + networking), ETA ~2-4h to provision.
Liam (Account Exec): FYI renewal call Wed 09:00 PT — this is material. Jordan, can you log the risk if we don't act?
Jordan: Risk = warning tier on account health; possible spike in 95th latency and ~1% error excess. Customer CSAT could drop. Recommend approve provisional window.
Rosa (Banyan): CIDRs: 54.68.0.0/16, 18.196.0.0/15. Start now, end +48h. Contact: ops@banyanhealth.com. Prefer eu-west-2 if that's faster to enable.
Priya (Infra): Applying allowlist + rate bump now, tagging the window as provisional. Will post confirmation when done.
deploy-bot: Rate window created: id=rwx-8721, org=banyan-health, multiplier=1.5, regions=[eu-west-2], expires=2026-03-25T14:00Z
Jordan: :thumbsup: Thanks Priya. Sam — can you schedule a 15-min post-change sync with Banyan to capture notes for the onboarding playbook and renewal pack?
Sam (Solutions Eng): on it. I'll record the session and push notes to the onboarding doc. Also logging a request to product for a quicker admin flow for temporary bumps.
Rosa (Banyan): seeing stability now, error tail dropped. Appreciate the quick help — will share post-mortem logs after the canary.
Jordan: I'll add a renewal note and capture this as a positive ops example in the CS playbook.
